verdict: Organic signals are the only activity; paid channels remain off across all three locations.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — generated zero paid spend and zero paid leads, so every inbound signal came from Google Business Profile activity. Combined, your three profiles produced 402 GBP actions (25 calls, 269 direction requests, and 108 web clicks) this period. Advance Grinding's profile surged 72.73% week-over-week, while Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision both saw GBP declines of roughly 57–61% in the same comparison — the net picture is mixed organic visibility with no paid volume behind it. Website tracking is being repaired across entities, so session data under-reports actual web interest right now. The immediate focus is resolving CRM account reconciliation and getting tracking restored so that when paid activity launches, every lead is captured cleanly from day one.
